name: Generic 1.5U CubeSat skeleton frame (CDS envelope)

document.title: CubeSat Design Specification (CDS) Rev 14.1, Cal Poly, 2022-02-09

source.notes: Envelope: CDS Rev 14.1; 6U/12U widths 226.3 mm per cubesat-specs summary of CDS (https://cubesat-specs.readthedocs.io). Rails 8.5 mm square (CDS 2.2.5 minimum). Mass is DERIVED: typical vendor primary-structure masses (ISIS 1U 100 g, EnduroSat 1U 120 g, 3U 243-290 g, 6U 850-900 g); 1.5U, 2U, 12U interpolated. 6U/12U drawn as two-bay skeleton frames with a middle rail pair (schematic).

material: aluminium 6061/6082 (typical; CDS requires 7075, 6061, 5005 or 5052 for rails)
mass_note: derived from vendor structures, see source.notes
